description: Promote the forward incoming-input-source index from a whole-closure build to an ascending contributed fact (InputSources, keyed by the (function,arrow,need) dispatch key, mirroring ReturnDemand). Each producer's DeriveExecutableTransport contributes its outgoing call-arg + capture edges, computed from its OWN facts alone -- no closure scan. Both transport jobs build their incoming index by reading the joined fact (current reads, so they re-run as siblings contribute). The shadow test keeps the in-process build. Byte-identical batch output; gate retained (the gate-drop is the final step).
title: Stage 4b: InputSources contribution fact (forward push as ascending fact)
